newsitem.title: USA: Today's Man to file amended reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Today's Man to file amended reorganization plan.

text.p: Today's Man Inc said Thursday that it will amend its reorganization plan to revise the financing from an all cash payout to a combination of cash and $15 million in equity to certain creditors.
The company said it believes that the revised plan provides for equitable treatment of all of its stakeholders while allowing for a healthier balance sheet for ongoing operations and expansion.
"With the turnaround complete and our financing in place, I am confident that emergence from Chapter 11 prior to the holiday selling season is attainable," said chairman David Feld.

"The fact that the only major issue remaining on the table is the payment of post-petition interest -- which we believe the creditors' are not legally entitled to receive -- is further evidence of the viability of the plan."
The essential elements of the plan, which provide the creditors with 100 percent recovery of allowed claims, and funding for payment of the company's debts and ongoing operations remain unchanged.
